text: On the Gudauri (post)–Kobi section, vehicle traffic is prohibited.
On the Gudauri (Post)-Kobi section, vehicle traffic is prohibited, – this information is being disseminated by the Roads Department of the Ministry of Infrastructure of Georgia.
As stated in the information from the Roads Department, the avalanche hazard level on this section is high.

“According to the Roads Department of the Ministry of Infrastructure of Georgia, and based on information from the National Environmental Agency, the avalanche danger level is high on the Gudauri (Posta)-Kobi section of the Mtskheta-Stepantsminda-Larsi international highway. Therefore, the movement of all types of motor vehicles is temporarily prohibited on this section.
According to the National Environmental Agency, traffic on the Mleta-Gudauri section will be carried out in a nonstop passing mode,” the statement says.
